utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve been hearing folks mention the repair drive all over town, but it’s still mostly a patchwork to me. If you want, I can keep my ears open and bring back anything solid.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Ira. Let’s keep it simple: bring me anything confirmed, and I’ll stick to the plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll only bring back what I can confirm. I’ll check around and report anything solid as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I’m in between rides, so just give me the quick version of the repair drive and I’ll catch up fast.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s this Saturday at the community shed. Bring tools, gloves, and whatever parts you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Saturday at the community shed. I’ll bring my gloves and whatever parts I can grab between rides.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not comfortable moving ahead on the repair drive without confirmation and a source I can check. Can you send me the details or the notice so I can verify it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — I’ll send the notice and the details so you can check them yourself. I’d rather have everything confirmed before we move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — send the notice and details when you can, and I’ll review them before I confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thank you, Oren. I’ll write down that you’re willing to help, and I’ll come back with the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Cleo—just remind me when it’s all sorted out, and I’ll do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to verify the details of the repair drive before I commit to anything. What exactly needs fixing, and who confirmed it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not fully sure yet — I may be working off stale details. Let me check who confirmed it and what the repair list is, then I’ll get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — please verify it first, and then send me the confirmed repair list and who approved it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late to this—what’s the plan for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we’re still nailing down the basics, but the idea is to collect tools, match folks with a few quick fix jobs, and sort the drop-off spot. I can fill you in as soon as we lock the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help with the tool run and quick fixes once you’ve got the list together. Just send me the drop-off spot when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Just point me to what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — start with the porch rail at the community hall, then swing by Mrs. Alvarez’s gate if you’ve got time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll start with the porch rail at the community hall, then I’ll swing by Mrs. Alvarez’s gate if I’ve got time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive details in hand—just point me to the exact spot you want me to verify, and I’ll pin it down for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Can you check the east side entrance by the lot? I’m trying to fit this around pickup, so I need the quickest update you can give me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’m heading to the east side entrance by the lot now, and I’ll give you the fastest precise update I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve been hearing the repair drive’s coming together fast, but I don’t have the full details yet. I’ll pass along anything confirmed as soon as I know it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Tess — I’ll start spreading the word as soon as we’ve got the confirmed details. The quicker we share it, the more neighbors we’ll get helping out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and share the confirmed details right away. Hopefully we can get a good crowd together for it!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Which repair drive are we talking about, and what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The one for the community center—mostly the loose wiring and that broken front hinge. I’m still piecing it together, so I wanted to ask what you’ve heard.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So we’re talking about the community center repair drive, and the reported issues are loose wiring and a broken front hinge. What’s the source on that, and who’s coordinating the fix?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive—yeah, we’re lining up the usual plan and keeping it simple. I’ll share the details once everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’m still getting the lay of the land, so I’ll watch for the details. Let me know if there’s anything I should pass along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’m going to keep repeating the plan until it settles, then I’ll pass it along to you. If anything shifts, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m keeping the repair drive details tidy and I’ll double-check any changes before I send them out. If anything shifts, I’ll make sure everyone in the group chat knows right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good. Let me know if you need me to check anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I may take you up on that. I’ll ping you if I need a quick check before I post anything to the group chat.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive might be getting a pretty good turnout, but I’m waiting to hear the exact details before I say more.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m fine with waiting, but I’d like the exact time and place before I commit. Once I have that, I can stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — as soon as I get the exact time and place, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late to this—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Dane — the latest is we’re still on for the repair drive, and I’m just lining up the usual helpers and supplies. If you can, bring whatever tools you’ve got and I’ll repeat the plan once more when the group’s set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll bring my tools and catch up when everyone’s set. If you need anything specific, just point me at it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’m in for the repair drive — just tell me what needs doing and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks. I’m still sorting the list, but I’m sure we’ll need hands for hauling and cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — just point me to the hauling or cleanup when you’re ready, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m on it — give me the gist of the repair drive and I’ll keep us moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is the neighborhood push to get the basics fixed fast—think safety issues, broken fixtures, and anything affecting daily use. I can help us keep it tight and specific if you want the list broken down by location.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll do that — I’m looping through the block anyway, so I’ll check back later and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’m happy to help keep the repair drive moving and spread the word where I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate that. I’ll double-check the details first, then I’ll pass along anything confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the date, time, and drop-off spot, then send you the exact details right away so we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh — right, the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still waiting on the final list, but I haven’t forgotten the repair drive. As soon as I’ve got it, I’ll share it with you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — thanks, Mara. I’ll wait for the final list and keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam, though folks are still bringing in all sorts of odds and ends. I can run by again later and see what’s changed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, sounds about right — I can keep a few tools and a bit of elbow grease ready, and we’ll see what comes in. Swing by later and I’ll be around somewhere nearby.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what do you need me to take a look at for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just need you on the repair drive. I’ll send the details when I have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, I’m on it — send the details when you’re ready and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to get the plan nailed down early—who’s handling what, and what time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need the exact start time first, and then I can assign roles. If you want, give me the list of tasks and I’ll map them out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Fair enough—let’s start at 9:00 and I’ll send you the task list right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll spread the word about the repair drive right away, and I'll make sure everyone in the neighborhood hears about it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thank you, Quinn. I’ll note that you’re handling the word, and I’ll keep my list updated as we go.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it—I'll start inviting folks now and keep you posted on who’s coming. If you want, I can also point people toward the most needed repairs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need a bit more from Oren first—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when would it fit around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m a bit foggy on the timing. Let me think it through with you, and I can fit it around school pickup if we choose the right day.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works—just give me a day and a rough window, and I’ll see what fits between pickup and dinner.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yeah, keep it tight—start with the biggest safety issues and break it down by location. I can move fast if you give me the top few stops.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll start with the biggest safety issues and group them by location. I can give you the top few stops first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you — send me the top few stops first, and I’ll make sure everyone’s on the same page. If anything changes, I’ll update the chat right away.
